name: Sbu Alarm

replaces.name: Alarmy - Loud alarm clock
replaces.price_model: freemium with ads, Premium subscription with 7-day trial

one_thing: Wakes you up and does not stop until you have completed a mission.

features.name: Alarms
features.description: Time, repeat days, label, on/off; list of alarms; next alarm as the screen figure.
features.reason: The base the paying user relies on.

features.name: Dismiss missions
features.description: To stop the alarm for good you complete a mission: math problems, memory grid, shake count. Difficulty and count per alarm.
features.reason: Alarmy's core and its premium hook ("Alarm Missions").

features.name: Snooze limits
features.description: Snooze length and maximum number of snoozes, or no snooze.
features.reason: Anti-Snooze for heavy sleepers in the listing.

features.name: Loud alarm sounds
features.description: Bundled original CAF sounds (no assets from Alarmy), preview, gradual volume.
features.reason: Users stay for the loud effective sounds.

features.name: Wake-up check
features.description: A few minutes after the mission a notification asks "Are you up?"; no answer re-rings the alarm.
features.reason: Review: "I do the game and go back to sleep"; premium in the original.

features.name: Rings with the app closed
features.description: iOS 26+: AlarmKit alarm that rings like the system Clock in silent mode and Focus. iOS 17-25 fallback: chain of time-sensitive local notifications with a 30 s sound each minute, cancelled by the mission; warning row if the ringer is likely muted.
features.reason: 28 reviews: the alarm did not ring, rang late or only vibrated unless the app was open.

features.name: No background drain
features.description: Nothing runs at night: no silent audio, no background refresh, no sleep recording.
features.reason: 16 reviews: 25-67% of the battery used in background.

features.name: Mission guard alarm
features.description: Stopping the system alert is not the end: a follow-up alarm is scheduled a few minutes later and cancelled only when the mission is done, so dismissing from the lock screen is safe.
features.reason: 10 reviews: cannot dismiss from the lock screen, Face ID fights the alarm, must hunt for the app.

features.name: Volume ramp and cap
features.description: Fade-in over a chosen time and a maximum level; vibration follows the per-alarm toggle.
features.reason: 4 reviews: forced max volume hurts or not loud enough; 3 about vibration ignoring the setting.

features.name: Own sound from Files
features.description: Import an audio file, trimmed and converted on device to a CAF under 30 s for both AlarmKit and the fallback.
features.reason: 3 reviews: no custom sound, no mp3.

features.name: Photo mission
features.description: Take a photo of a chosen place (sink, book); Vision feature-print comparison on device.
features.reason: Alarmy's best-known mission; 3 reviews about it failing.

features.name: Spoken time
features.description: AVSpeechSynthesizer reads the time and label after the mission.

features.name: Bedtime reminder
features.description: Local notification at a chosen bedtime.

screens.name: Alarms
screens.purpose: All alarms; the next one is the figure.
elements: next alarm time (SbuStat + SbuFullStop in accent-alarm)
time until it rings in inkMuted
warning rows (success/warning + SF Symbol + text): notifications off, AlarmKit denied, iOS 17-25 silent-mode limit

screens.name: Ringing
screens.purpose: Shown when the app opens from the alert or notification.

screens.name: Mission
elements: math problem / memory grid / shake counter / camera
alarm keeps sounding at low volume in-app

flows.name: First alarm
steps: Allow alarms (AlarmKit authorization, iOS 26) or notifications (iOS 17-25) from the Save button

flows.name: Wake up (iOS 26+)
steps: AlarmKit alert rings on the lock screen
Tap Mission (secondary button opens the app via App Intent) or Stop
If Stop without mission: guard alarm rings after N minutes

flows.name: Wake up (iOS 17-25)
steps: Time-sensitive notification with 30 s sound, repeated every minute
Tap it: app opens on Ringing and plays the sound

flows.name: Wake-up check
steps: Tap I'm up or the alarm rings again

fields.name: sound
fields.note: bundled or imported CAF in Library/Sounds

fields.name: maxVolume
fields.note: in-app playback only; AlarmKit uses system volume

fields.name: guardAlarmIDs
fields.note: pending AlarmKit guard alarms or notification ids

fields.name: reference
fields.note: photo feature print or barcode payload

data_model.storage: SwiftData on device; imported sounds converted to CAF in Library/Sounds. Nothing in background, no server.

monetization.model: Free with ads; Premium subscription with 7-day free trial; previous lifetime purchases moved to yearly.
monetization.price: Reviews: €7.49/month, $60 after the trial, "$100+ a year"; exact plans not in the lookup data
paywalled_features: premium missions and heavy-sleeper options (Wake-up check, Anti-Snooze); exact split not in public data
monetization.notes: Listing says alarm, sleep tracker and sleep sounds are free. Subscription not Family Sharing (review).

skipped.reason: All-night microphone and background audio: the battery drain users hate; health claims (1.4.1).
Not possible with public APIs on iOS (2.5.1).

skipped.feature: Apple Music / Spotify as alarm sound
skipped.reason: AlarmKit and notifications need a local sound file; DRM tracks cannot be used.
Body-pose camera mission is heavy for the estimate; later P2.
Entitlement is for health and safety apps; not requested.
2.5.4: background audio only for audible content; Noise's in-app alarm works because a real sleep sound plays.

system_frameworks.name: AlarmKit
system_frameworks.use: system-grade alarms (silent mode, Focus), Stop + secondary Mission button, countdown snooze; fallback below 26: UserNotifications chain

system_frameworks.name: ActivityKit / WidgetKit
system_frameworks.use: AlarmKit presentation widget for countdown/paused states (Live Activity required by AlarmKit)

system_frameworks.name: App Intents
system_frameworks.use: secondary button opens the app on the mission; Stop/Snooze intents

system_frameworks.name: UserNotifications (time-sensitive)
system_frameworks.use: iOS 17-25 alarm chain and wake-up check

system_frameworks.name: AVFoundation
system_frameworks.use: in-app ringing with fade-in, sound import and CAF conversion

system_frameworks.name: Vision + VisionKit
system_frameworks.use: photo feature print and barcode missions

review_risks.risk: Six Sbu 1.0 apps were rejected together on 14/10 for duplicates and opportunistic variants; same "Sbu X" naming, identical promise block, shared SbuKit.
review_risks.mitigation: Submit alone, never in a batch; answer the nine Resolution Center questions in the review notes; add a "How it differs from the other Sbu apps" line; distinct engraving icon and screenshots.

review_risks.risk: Shared SbuKit and generated project can read as a template app.
review_risks.mitigation: Review notes state who wrote it, what is shared (design system only) and what is specific to this app.
Privacy policy in metadata and Settings; every permission asked only from the button that needs it, with an IT/EN string naming that button; label "Data Not Collected".

review_risks.risk: Sbu Noise already ships an alarm with fade-in and an AlarmKit fallback (#417, #424); a second Sbu app with alarms and shared alarm code answers "why not a feature of another app" badly.
review_risks.mitigation: Noise wakes you gently while a sleep sound plays; Alarm makes you get up with missions and rings with no sound playing. Keep Noise's alarm as is, write the notes line, do not submit while Noise's 4.3 reply is pending.

review_risks.risk: Alarm clocks sit next to "simple timers"; a plain alarm would be spam.
review_risks.mitigation: Missions, guard alarm and wake-up check are the difference; screenshots lead with a mission.

review_risks.risk: Alarmy's missions, sounds and screens are distinctive.
review_risks.mitigation: Own sounds, Sbu screens, no Alarmy name in metadata, mission set described generically.

review_risks.risk: AlarmKit is iOS 26+ and needs NSAlarmKitUsageDescription; below 26 no public API rings in silent mode, and silent background audio is forbidden.
review_risks.mitigation: AlarmKit behind #available; iOS 17-25 uses notifications and says honestly (warning row) that silent mode mutes them.

review_risks.risk: Must not look like the Clock app's alarm list or AlarmKit's system alert styled as Apple's.
review_risks.mitigation: Sbu design system; AlarmKit alert uses accent-alarm tint and app-specific title.
Asked only when the user picks that mission; on-device Vision only.
